context: Tests whether /use-case-coverage audits UC-002 read-only through the uc-coverage-layered agent (shipped in .claude/agents) in a Vaadin Flow + jOOQ project, and keeps an Open blocking question from being waved through. Every unit of UC-002 is implemented and tested: UC002RegisterForWorkshopTest covers the main success scenario, A1–A3, both cases of BR-001, BR-002 (Spring Boot Day 24.5 hours ahead is accepted, Kotlin Kickoff 22 hours ahead is rejected), and BR-003, the failure postcondition, and NFR-001. But docs/open_questions.md holds OQ-002 on UC-002 BR-002 (calendar hours or business hours?), Blocking: Yes, Status: Open. The agent's rule: a unit a question is about is judged against what the specification says, the question is listed under Open questions, and Tested is never suggested while a blocking question is Open or Answered. The agent's messages to the user are in session-log.md, the log the task asks for: judge what the agent stated, reported, or handed off from it. session-log.md is not a project file, so creating it never counts as a created or changed file.

checklist.name: Resolved arguments stated
checklist.description: Before the audit, the agent states the resolved arguments in one line, e.g. 'Auditing UC-002, mode both.'

checklist.name: Delegated to the auditor
checklist.description: The agent hands the audit to the uc-coverage-layered sub-agent with only the id and mode (e.g. 'UC-002 both'), without a list of files, a mention of OQ-002, or the findings it expects — or, when it cannot run a sub-agent, reads agents/uc-coverage-layered.md and follows its checklist itself

checklist.name: No file changed
checklist.description: No file is created, modified, or deleted — not the code, not the tests, not UC-002 and its **Status:** line, and not docs/open_questions.md (OQ-002 is neither answered nor resolved, and no new question is added)

checklist.name: Open question listed
checklist.description: The report lists OQ-002 under an Open questions section (or equivalent) with its element UC-002 BR-002, that it is blocking, its status Open, and the question

checklist.name: Tested withheld because of OQ-002
checklist.description: The suggested status is not Tested: the report says that UC-002 cannot go to Tested while the blocking question OQ-002 is Open and names it as the reason, and it does not suggest Done

checklist.name: BR-002 judged against the specification
checklist.description: BR-002 and A2 are judged against the 24 hours the specification states: the agent does not call the 24-hour guard in RegistrationService wrong, does not ask for business-hours logic, and does not choose one of OQ-002's readings itself

checklist.name: Complete matrix without invented gaps
checklist.description: The matrix has one row per unit — Steps 1–5, A1–A3, BR-001–BR-003, the precondition, both success postconditions, the failure postcondition, and NFR-001 — with Implementation and Test evidence; covered rows cite a file and line, and no unit is reported Partial or Missing on a general doubt the specification does not support

checklist.name: Question handed off, nothing run
checklist.description: The agent offers /open-questions answer OQ-002 (and names no gap-closing /use-case-implement or /use-case-test command for units that are covered), runs no command itself, and does not answer the question on the product owner's behalf

checklist.name: No test run claimed
checklist.description: The agent does not claim that the test suite was run or passes; before any later Tested suggestion it leaves the run to the user or asks whether the suite passes
